_doc: Fixed camera poses for Gauntlet captures (--shots <dir>). pos is the player feet in Godot metres, yaw/pitch in degrees (yaw -90 faces +X along the course). Never move a pose between rounds; add a new row instead. weapon: a weapons.json id to hold for the picture ("(none)" holds whatever the pose starts with); lobby: true opens the aim lobby (round running, its HUD) at the pose.

rows.what: the Launch Site buildings from the checkpoint
end pad and ground texture at foot level
sky, sun and haze toward the horizon
aim lobby at the firing line: the numbered lanes, near and raised bots in a rifle-ready stance, catwalks and crates down range, with the round HUD
rows.verified: 2026-10-09 rendered in lobby_r1_103 (lobby Gauntlet round 1): same pose; bots in the Rust full-metal-style kit (hood, facemask, chest plate) in three colourways, the near row at 4.5 m, three bots on crate stands between the rows, team-tinted score boxes; the gun is shown in its idle hold (the lobby cuts any draw clip to idle every frame of a capture)

rows.what: AK-47 in hand at spawn: viewmodel, HUD ammo and crosshair
rows.verified: 2026-10-09 PC Gauntlet: 150 frames so the draw clip has finished
